title: "Longitudinal statistical framework"
output: html_document
date: "2026-04-22"
---
```{r}
# Load required libraries ------------------------------------
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)

# Load input data --------------------------------------------
# We use results_with_metadata2.csv
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# BUILD INFANT vOTU-LEVEL DATASET ----------------------------------------

df_votu <- df %>%
  filter(
    mother_infant == "infant",
    bodysite == "stool"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    presence = if_else(CPM > 0, 1L, 0L),

    subject = factor(subject),
    vOTUs = factor(vOTUs),

    timepoint_months = as.numeric(timepoint_months),
    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months)),

    Contact_BF = factor(Contact_BF),
    feeding_cat = factor(feeding_cat),
    Exclusive_BF = factor(Exclusive_BF),
    Diet = factor(Diet),
    delivery = factor(delivery),
    intrapartum_ATB = factor(intrapartum_ATB)
  )

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("DATASET SUMMARY\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("Infant stool vOTUs:", n_distinct(df_votu$vOTUs), "\n")
cat("Subjects:", n_distinct(df_votu$subject), "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(df_votu), "\n")

cat("\nOriginal delivery categories:\n")
print(table(df_votu$delivery, useNA = "ifany"))


# CREATE FINAL DELIVERY VARIABLES ------------------------------------------

df_votu <- df_votu %>%
  mutate(

    # Birth environment:
    # hospital = C-section + hospital vaginal
    # home = home birth
    birth_environment = case_when(
      delivery == "homebirth" ~ "home",
      delivery %in% c("vaginal", "csection") ~ "hospital",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    birth_environment = factor(
      birth_environment,
      levels = c("hospital", "home")
    ),

    # Delivery mode:
    # vaginal = hospital vaginal + home vaginal
    # csection = C-section
    delivery_binary = case_when(
      delivery %in% c("vaginal", "homebirth") ~ "vaginal",
      delivery == "csection" ~ "csection",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    delivery_binary = factor(
      delivery_binary,
      levels = c("csection", "vaginal")
    )
  )


cat("\nBirth environment coding:\n")
print(
  table(
    df_votu$delivery,
    df_votu$birth_environment,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

cat("\nDelivery mode coding:\n")
print(
  table(
    df_votu$delivery,
    df_votu$delivery_binary,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

# OVERALL AGE MODEL ---------------------------------------------------------

model_age_main <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled +
    (1 + timepoint_scaled | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# HUMAN MILK EXPOSURE MODEL -------------------------------------------------

model_contact_bf_main <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * Contact_BF +
    (1 + timepoint_scaled | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

# BIRTH ENVIRONMENT MODEL - HOME vs HOSPITAL --------------------------------

model_birth_environment <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * birth_environment +
    (1 + timepoint_scaled | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# DELIVERY MODE MODEL - VAGINAL vs C-SECTION -------------------------------

model_delivery_binary <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * delivery_binary +
    (1 + timepoint_scaled | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# INTRAPARTUM ANTIBIOTIC MODEL ---------------------------------------------

model_ATB_scaled <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * intrapartum_ATB +
    (1 + timepoint_scaled | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# DIET MODEL - Original random-intercept specification ----------------------

model_bin_diet <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * Diet +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# FEEDING CATEGORY MODEL - Original random-intercept specification ----------

# note: In the manuscript No breastfed = formula; Partially breastfed = mixed
model_presence_feed <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * feeding_cat +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# LOW-PREVALENCE vOTU FILTER ------------------------------------------------

votu_freq <- df_votu %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = sum(presence),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

votus_keep <- votu_freq %>%
  filter(n_samples >= 2) %>%
  pull(vOTUs)

df_votu_nosing <- df_votu %>%
  filter(vOTUs %in% votus_keep) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("\nRetained vOTUs after low-prevalence filtering:",
    n_distinct(df_votu_nosing$vOTUs), "\n")


# ROBUSTNESS: DIET ----------------------------------------------------------

model_bin_diet_nosing <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * Diet +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu_nosing,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# ROBUSTNESS: ORIGINAL 3-CATEGORY DELIVERY ----------------------------------

model_bin_delivery_nosing <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * delivery +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu_nosing,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# ROBUSTNESS: FEEDING CATEGORY ---------------------------------------------

model_presence_feed_nosing <- glmer(
  presence ~ timepoint_scaled * feeding_cat +
    (1 | subject) +
    (1 | vOTUs),
  data = df_votu_nosing,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)


# SAMPLE-LEVEL CPM DATASET -------------------------------------------------

cpm_df <- df_votu %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    subject,
    timepoint_months,
    feeding_cat,
    Contact_BF,
    Diet,
    delivery,
    intrapartum_ATB
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    richness = sum(presence, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_total_CPM = log10(total_CPM + 1),

    subject = factor(subject),
    feeding_cat = factor(feeding_cat),
    Contact_BF = factor(Contact_BF),
    Diet = factor(Diet),
    delivery = factor(delivery),
    intrapartum_ATB = factor(intrapartum_ATB),

    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months))
  )


# CPM MODELS --------------------------------------------------------------

model_cpm_feeding_cat <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * feeding_cat +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

model_cpm_contact_bf <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * Contact_BF +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

model_cpm_diet <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * Diet +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

model_cpm_delivery <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * delivery +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)

model_cpm_atb <- lmer(
  log_total_CPM ~ timepoint_scaled * intrapartum_ATB +
    (1 | subject),
  data = cpm_df
)


# ALL FINAL MODELS IN ONE LIST ---------------------------------------------

all_models <- list(

  Overall_age = model_age_main,

  Human_milk_exposure = model_contact_bf_main,

  Birth_environment_home_vs_hospital = model_birth_environment,

  Delivery_mode_vaginal_vs_csection = model_delivery_binary,

  Intrapartum_ATB = model_ATB_scaled,

  Diet_presence = model_bin_diet,

  Feeding_category_presence = model_presence_feed,

  Diet_no_rare_vOTUs = model_bin_diet_nosing,

  Delivery_3group_no_rare_vOTUs = model_bin_delivery_nosing,

  Feeding_category_no_rare_vOTUs = model_presence_feed_nosing,

  CPM_human_milk = model_cpm_contact_bf,

  CPM_diet = model_cpm_diet,

  CPM_feeding_category = model_cpm_feeding_cat,

  CPM_delivery_3group = model_cpm_delivery,

  CPM_ATB = model_cpm_atb
)


# PRINT FULL SUMMARY OF EVERY MODEL ----------------------------------------

for (nm in names(all_models)) {

  cat("\n\n")
  cat("############################################################\n")
  cat("MODEL:", nm, "\n")
  cat("############################################################\n\n")

  print(summary(all_models[[nm]]))

  if (inherits(all_models[[nm]], "merMod")) {

    cat("\nSingular fit:\n")
    print(isSingular(all_models[[nm]]))

    cat("\nConvergence messages:\n")
    print(all_models[[nm]]@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)
  }
}
```
